text:
emma-peopleops: Quick sync — final-day checklist for the performance cycle this Friday EOD PST. I put a short runbook below. Please confirm you’ve done your items or flag blockers. :wave:

ali-manager: Quick question — two of my ICs are on parental leave and won’t be submitting. What’s the official handoff process?

emma-peopleops: Good call. For LOA / parental leave we do manager handbacks. Steps: 1) mark status as "LOA-no-review" in the form 2) attach the LOA approval doc 3) add a short manager note in the final comments field. We’ll exclude them from calibration. If you want to transfer review to a backup manager, ping me with names.

rachel-eng: FYI I ran into an issue importing attachments into the review form: some GDrive links got stripped when we did the CSV import. Anyone else?

emma-peopleops: Yes that’s a known edge case — links with spaces or non-ascii chars get URL-encoded and the importer can drop them. Quick fix: re-upload via the UI or run this small export/import patch: ```bash
# export comments + attachments ids
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console.redwood.internal/api/reviews/export?cycle=2026-q1" > exports/2026_reviews.json
# reattach via our helper script
python tools/attach_fixes.py exports/2026_reviews.json
```
I’ll also queue a retry job for the affected rows tonight at 10pm PST.

mike-manager: Can managers delegate final submission to backups? My co-manager is OOTO tomorrow.

emma-peopleops: Yes — managers can set a reviewer delegate. Steps: 1) open the review in the UI 2) click "Assign backup reviewer" 3) add backup and a short note. We need an explicit manager signal — we can’t auto-assign.

jess-recruiter: Heads up — two new hires start mid-cycle (Tue). Do we keep them in this cycle or cut them a shorter ramp review?

emma-peopleops: For hires starting during the review window we do a partial-cycle check: include them only if they’ve been active >= 14 days before the end of the cycle. Otherwise we mark "onboarding review" and plan a 3-month check-in. Add me the new hire names and start dates and I’ll tag them in the CSV.

ali-manager: Thanks — I’ll DM the LOA docs to you now. Also: who handles calibration slots if a manager can’t attend?

emma-peopleops: We have backup facilitators. If you can’t make your assigned calibration, please update the slot in the calendar and set a backup. If no backup available, escalate to me and we’ll reassign.

ops_bot: [Reminder] Performance cycle export job scheduled: exports/2026_reviews.json will run at 2026-05-14T03:00:00Z. Status: queued. :calendar:

rachel-eng: Thanks for the patch example, emma. I’ll try the UI reupload for the 4 rows now and report back.

emma-peopleops: Perfect. Final quick checklist for Friday EOD PST: 
- managers: submit final notes and ratings OR assign backup reviewer
- people-ops: run export + start calibration prep at 11pm PST
- eng leads: confirm any LOA exceptions (DM me)
- recruiters: flag new hires starting mid-cycle
- ops: run attachment retry job at 10pm PST (I’ll monitor)

If anything blocks you, drop it here or DM me. Appreciate quick thumbs so we can close the loop. :thumbsup:
